The Cat and The Cannabis, Not By Dr. Seuss  -- Medical Marijuana Isn't Just For People

To MarijuanaNews:

In the midst of all that is going on in the world today, can you stand one more cat/cannabis story?

See
Pets And Medical Marijuana -- Two More Cases For Mace Ventura, Pet Narc
(Ace’s Evil Twin; There’s A Movie In Here Somewhere.)

Here’s what’s happened:

My 4 year old cat has developed a wheeze which can be clearly heard when she is very relaxed, or asleep, and the consensus of all the cat mavens with whom I’ve consulted, is that she, the cat, has developed asthma.

Hmmm. What to do?

So, two nights ago, while she was asleep and wheezing again, I blew a puff of you-know-what into her face. I gave her three "doses" and THE WHEEZING STOPPED FOR THE REST OF THE NIGHT - just as advertised!!!

I gave her another dose last night while she was wheezing again, and, lo and behold, the wheezing stopped again. Do you think I could get her enrolled into the Class Action suit? Whadaya think? ;-)

Best wishes,

D

(Marijuananews note: I doubt if a cat could be enrolled in the Class Action, which is too bad. Americans sometimes seem to care more about animal suffering than human suffering. Why isn’t there the militancy of PETA to oppose the cruelty to medical marijuana users?)
